stage: the book projection reads authored JSON through one safe accessor

result.the_pattern_named: a cast such as (string?)node["field"] THROWS when the node holds an object or an array. That crash reached my projections three times in three files before it was named as a pattern, and a projection must REPORT bad content rather than take Studio down
result.the_helper: AuthoredJson, with two shapes because callers want different things: Text answers 'the field as a string, or the empty string' and TextOrNull answers 'the field as a string, or null when it is not one'. The null-preserving shape is what kept the conversion behaviour-identical where the code really depended on null
result.the_conversion: PhotoBook.cs went from twenty-one such casts to ZERO, and the probe's numbers did not move: thirteen photos, five worlds, thirty-three facts, two evidence, seven anchors, zero problems, sixty-four indexing gaps and seventeen fact gates - identical to before
result.the_rest: about ninety casts remain across the other projection files, and they will be converted file by file in later stages rather than in one unreviewable sweep
